subject: inla.tmarginal parameter transformation based on two parameters

messages.author: c52d421e18f03e10
messages.subject: inla.tmarginal parameter transformation based on two parameters
parts:
Dear all,

I am running some models using inla.spde2.pcmatern, and I would like to look at the posterior distribution of Stdev^2*Precision

Model hyperparameters:
                                            mean       sd 0.025quant 0.5quant 0.975quant     mode
Precision for the Gaussian observations   3.6983   0.0443     3.6068   3.7005     3.7800   3.7088
Range for s1                            536.5715 565.9881    95.9620 366.6810  1999.4797 206.5872
Stdev for s1                              0.0698   0.0471     0.0099   0.0599     0.1844   0.0302

However, I did not find a way to supply two marginal objects to inla.tmarginal() function.

Is there a way to do this in r-inla?

Thanks,
Craig

messages.author: c52d421e18f03e10
messages.subject: Re: inla.tmarginal parameter transformation based on two parameters
parts: I think I can obtain it using inla.hyperpar.sample() first to draw samples first and then compute the ratio myself.
